fields.System.Title: OUT-506 — Multi-carton orders
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a packer, I want to split a large order across several boxes, so that orders that do
not fit in one carton can still be packed and tracked.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an order, then any number of cartons can be opened against it.
  • - Given several cartons, then each is labelled "box N of M" once all are closed.
  • - Given any carton unlabelled, then the order cannot be released to shipping.
  • - Given the cartons together, then their combined contents must exactly match the picked
  • quantities.
  • - Given a carton, then each item appears in exactly one carton — never counted twice.
